2034121.title: Gijang Eupseong Fortress Festival
2034121.overview: Gijang, on the coast just north of Busan, holds this small heritage festival around its old town fortress from 9 to 11 October 2026, on the lawn in front of the Gijang Modern History Museum and in the museum itself. The programme mixes performances, reading, film and hands-on activities: a music bar, a book concert, traditional folk performance, a dance challenge, a reading club and even a pet-video contest. Inside the museum there are pop-up craft workshops, a slow-down healing corner and docent-led walks along the fortress walls. Running all weekend are a charm-making corner, a 'pet rock' adoption booth and play zones for children. Free.
2034121.place: Gijang Janggwancheong and Gijang Modern History Museum

1620571.title: Poeun Cultural Festival
1620571.overview: Jeong Mong-ju, known by his pen name Poeun, was the Goryeo scholar-statesman whose loyalty to the fallen dynasty made him one of the great moral figures of Korean history. The 22nd Poeun Cultural Festival, on 10 and 11 October 2026 at his tomb in Mohyeon, Yongin, marks 620 years since his remains were moved here. It opens with a procession re-enacting the reburial and a memorial rite, followed by a ceremony, performances, Yongin's folk arts festival and a concert by winners of a national youth gugak competition. Children can sit a mock royal civil-service exam, and there are traditional-culture activities, food trucks and a local farm market. Free.
1620571.place: Tomb of Jeong Mong-ju (Poeun), Mohyeon, Yongin

790211.title: A+ Festival: Disability Arts Festival
790211.overview: A three-day arts festival where disabled and non-disabled artists perform and exhibit side by side, held from 16 to 18 October 2026 on Magok Plaza in Gangseo-gu, western Seoul. This year's theme is 'a shining story of the stars': different stars forming one constellation. The programme covers music, dance and theatre, an exhibition of work by disabled artists, collaborative stages, and activities that visitors can join in. Free, afternoons and evenings.
790211.sponsor: Korea Federation of Disability Culture and Arts Organizations

4115702.title: Seocho AI Festa
4115702.overview: A one-day festival of hands-on artificial intelligence run by Seocho District on Saturday 17 October 2026, from 10:00 to 18:00 at Seocho Culture and Arts Park in Yangjae. Six themed zones let visitors try AI in daily life, education, creative work, healthcare and public services. The main stage has a physical-AI robot show, an AI quiz, AI cinema, robot performances and talk shows, and around the park there are a digital-nomad zone, a stamp tour, a travelling AI library, coffee trucks and food trucks. Companies and institutes including KT, ESTsoft, KETI and Nongshim take part. Free; most content is in Korean.
4115702.place: Seocho Culture and Arts Park, Yangjae

623494.title: Paju Gaeseong Ginseng Festival
623494.overview: Paju, on the border north of Seoul, grows ginseng in the tradition of Gaeseong, the old Goryeo capital just across the DMZ that was once Korea's ginseng capital. The festival is held at Imjingak, the park on the edge of the Civilian Control Line, under the theme 'DMZ Gaeseong ginseng, strength like magic'. The main reason to come is the farmers' direct-sale market, where you can buy fresh ginseng straight from growers. There are also a national ginseng cooking contest with about twenty teams, busking and stage performances, exhibitions, a ginseng auction, and free and paid activities for all ages. It combines well with a DMZ day. Free entry.
